name: @dina/a2a
description: Dina's A2A (Agent2Agent v1.0) edge contract: v1.0 wire types and validators, JSON-RPC envelope, RFC 8785 canonical JSON, Agent Card projection, signing and pinning, the Dina invocation envelope, workflow/A2A state maps, result sanitation, and the Lane 3 directory envelope and fence. Zero runtime deps; crypto is injected (docs/A2A_GATEWAY_ARCHITECTURE.md §4.2).
